quotes.text: The D210021 cleanup removed unused contact-photo, invalid-email, mailing-list-title, and prefix strings from addressBook.properties. It did not remove the bundle: address-book code still reads active keys such as ldap_2.servers.pab.description. Bug 1852699 is a broad dead-code umbrella, so this lesson is scoped to the verified removed keys, not a claim that all address-book properties are obsolete. Check real references before deleting localization keys; the current checkout still has this properties bundle and the deleted keys have no references in the searched mail/mailnews tree.
